title: Two errands on one trip
odia: ହାଟକୁ ଗଲେ କନ୍ୟା ଦେଖିବି ବାଇଗଣ ବିକିବି ଦି କାମ କରିବି
literal_meaning: At the market I will look for a bride and sell brinjals: I will do two tasks.
explanation: One outing is made to serve two purposes. The unexpected pairing gives the plan its humour.
meaning_odia: ଗୋଟିଏ ଥର ଯିବାରେ ଦୁଇଟି କାମ ସାରିବାର ଯୋଜନା। କାମ ଦୁଇଟିର ଅଲଗା ସ୍ୱଭାବରେ ମଜା ଅଛି।
usage_example: Someone collects a repaired bicycle while returning a borrowed book nearby. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The dictionary places this under seeking. It does not establish a marriage custom or imply buying a bride.
